LESSON: WEATHER ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: NATURAL 3.2 Animals By the end of the sub- • Learners could be guided to name 1.
Topic 3.3: Weather ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Weather ENVIRONMENT. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. observe weather conditions in the immediate environment
2. appreciate different weather conditions in the environment weather conditions talking about the activities associated with different weather conditions simulations/videos of different weather conditions Core-Competences to be developed: 143

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. observe weather conditions in the immediate environment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to observe weather conditions in the immediate environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate different weather conditions in the environment weather conditions talking about the activities associated with different weather conditions simulations/videos of different weather conditions Core-Competences to be developed: 143
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate different weather conditions in the environment weather conditions talking about the activities associated with different weather conditions simulations/videos of different weather conditions Core-Competences to be developed: 143. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Weather ENVIRONMENT.
2. Explain Weather ENVIRONMENT to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Weather ENVIRONMENT.
4. Show that you can: observe weather conditions in the immediate environment
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Weather ENVIRONMENT. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Weather ENVIRONMENT important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. observe weather conditions in the immediate environment
2. appreciate different weather conditions in the environment weather conditions talking about the activities associated with different weather conditions simulations/videos of different weather conditions Core-Competences to be developed: 143

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
